aka: ユー・キャノット・ビー・シリアス！
trans_title: ユー・キャノット・ビー・シリアス！
introduction: Natsumi's whirlwind trip to New York unexpectedly resulted in a big surprise: she discovered she was pregnant. Initially set on securing a simple abortion, she was stunned to learn that her pregnancy was far more advanced than she had anticipated. Confronted with the grim details of a mid-term abortion, she decides to keep the baby on the spur of the moment, despite her fears of sacrificing her vibrant career and life as an independent woman. Without a shred of confidence and zero parenting aspirations, Natsumi decided it was time to drop a significant bombshell on her mother, Tokiko, who had long given up hope of ever becoming a grandmother. When Natsumi revealed that she would be having a half-American baby, it sparked a profound shift in their family dynamic. In her eccentric way, Tokiko eagerly began to support Natsumi's journey toward childbirth. In spite of Tokiko's enthusiastic support, Natsumi felt overwhelmed, and the thought of becoming a parent only intensified her anxiety. When she arrived at the hospital on the big day, a wave of dread washed over her. However, she soon realized that there was an unexpected challenge ahead that she had never seen coming.
